# cq-cross-hole-bounds

Shrunk from the 5 `shaft_collar` programs of [BenchCAD](https://huggingface.co/datasets/BenchCAD/BenchCAD) `code_gen` at revision `5919f578ab09ec283603a082fab07c7639ab56eb`, [CC-BY-4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), that end `ok` on both sides and no rule classes (`_004211`, `_004399`, `_007583`, `_017335`, `_017997`, all `_s20260505`); the shape of the programs, not their text. Each is a collar (a cylinder, bored by `faces(sel).workplane().hole(d)`) cut across by a set-screw hole, a thin cylinder along a diameter, at mid-height or (two of them) on an end face. The bore and the `hole` are not at fault: the same cross hole in the solid cylinder, with no `hole`, ends the same. Here a cylinder of radius 2, z 0..2, is drilled across along y at z = 1 by a hole of radius 0.5.

Two kernels, two measures, both held to the closed form of `expected.json`'s `note`:

- arris 0.10.0 builds the closed form's volume, area and centroid (to 3e-10, 6e-10 and 4e-11), but its body box reaches y = +-2.0012288786, 1.23e-3 past the cylinder, where ADR-0005 holds a box to the part's extent plus the kernel's padding (2e-7). `Model.bounds` of each of the two edges the hole leaves on the side wall (NURBS curves) gives that box, and the side wall's box is the union of its edges'; a tessellation at a chord of 1e-4 reaches |y| = 2.000000003. The geometry is the closed form's; its box is not. arris documents a NURBS curve's box as its control hull's, an outer bound (`DATA-MODEL.md`, `Curve::bounds`), so no arris query gives this body a tight box. In the five corpus rows the gap is 5e-4 to 1e-3 along the axis the set screw runs; each row's apex of the cross hole on the collar's outer wall is the part's extent there.
- CadQuery 2.3.0 gives the cylinder's box (to its 1e-7), but a volume 3.1e-5 and an area 1.1e-5 off (relative) and a centroid 2.6e-5 in x off the closed form (V = 22.015212372824433, A = 61.04907558671789, x̄ = 2.58e-5 where the part is symmetric in x): Open CASCADE wrong, as on the other cylinder-cylinder sections of the table (`t_pipe_fitting`). Its record is `oracle.json`, the report of `uv run tools/oracle_run.py tests/fixtures/regression/cq-cross-hole-bounds/program.py` (2026-11-14, `seconds` left out); the fixture holds arris, and the rows' class comes from arris's box.

Since both sides miss the closed form, no closed-form verdict passes `compare` (it holds the exonerated side to it), and the 5 rows are `arris_bug` by this fixture (`tests/fixtures/c2/benchcad/verdicts.json`): once arris reports a tight box they are `occt_wrong` by a closed form.

Desired: `ok`, the closed form, bounds included. Marked strict `xfail` until an arris release boxes a body to its extent where a NURBS edge reaches it. Reported to arris in `../arris/docs/ideas/tight-body-bounds.md`.
